2609.35456.title: AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain--Computer Interfaces
2609.35456.paper_summary: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. Across 14 EEG datasets spanning motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging, we evaluate AutoBCI with six LLMs, including Opus 5.5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, and compare the architectures selected by the search procedure against ten baselines: six conventional EEG models and four foundation models. The architecture discovered by AutoBCI with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves 64.16% average test balanced accuracy (bAcc), compared with 63.87% for REVE, the strongest baseline on this metric. Using ten observed epochs, PEEK reduces mean absolute error in predicting average validation bAcc from 2.20 to 1.36 percentage points, a 38.1% reduction relative to the best-observed-score baseline.
2609.35456.paper_summary_zh: EEG 基於腦機介面的應用範圍廣泛，但設計能在多樣任務中表現良好的解碼架構仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>我們介紹 AutoBCI，一個代理框架，其中設計代理和預測代理支持在不同任務中發現和選擇 EEG 解碼架構。<lb/>設計代理執行池引導架構發現（PGAD），通過在多個 EEG 任務（如情感識別、運動意象和睡眠分期）中的訓練和驗證生成和完善架構。<lb/>預測代理執行早期知識的性能估計（PEEK），利用架構代碼、訓練協議和早期學習曲線來預測全預算驗證性能，並選擇有前景的候選者進行持續訓練。<lb/>在涵蓋運動意象、情感識別和睡眠分期的 14 個 EEG 數據集上，我們使用六個 LLM（包括 Opus 5.5 和 GPT 5.6 Sol）評估 AutoBCI，並將搜索程序選擇的架構與十個基準進行比較：六個傳統 EEG 模型和四個基礎模型。<lb/>AutoBCI 與 Claude Opus 5.5 發現的架構在測試中的平均平衡準確率（bAcc）達到 64.16%，相比之下，REVE 在這一指標上為 63.87%，是最強的基準。<lb/>使用十個觀察到的時期，PEEK 將預測平均驗證 bAcc 的平均絕對誤差從 2.20 降低到 1.36 個百分點，相對於最佳觀察分數基準降低了 38.1%。
